Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of aggregate NAV (Investor Shares) — a FUND-level cap; at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.
Scenario demand (illustrative): 7.2% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity — adequate headroom at this allocation if offers are not prorated.
Early repurchase economics: 5.0% of NAV if repurchased within 24 months (2.7) — relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
